queries.title: Agency reports filed, by form
queries.method: Each row of Agency report fixture is one report an agency or official filed. The form is read from the first eight characters of the filing type, and the date from the first ten characters of the filing date. A behested payment is a payment made to a third party at an official's request; the report is the official's own disclosure.
queries.sql:
WITH reports AS (
 SELECT SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("filing_type" AS VARCHAR))), 1, 8) AS form,
  TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST("filing_date" AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS filed_on,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("official" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS official
 FROM "analysis_agency_reports"
)
SELECT form, COUNT(*) AS reports, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE filed_on IS NULL) AS undated,
 CAST(MIN(filed_on) AS VARCHAR) AS first_filed, CAST(MAX(filed_on) AS VARCHAR) AS last_filed
FROM reports GROUP BY form ORDER BY reports DESC, form LIMIT 12

queries.title: Behested payment reports, by the official named
queries.method: Each row of Agency report fixture is one report an agency or official filed. The form is read from the first eight characters of the filing type, and the date from the first ten characters of the filing date. A behested payment is a payment made to a third party at an official's request; the report is the official's own disclosure. A report that names no official is counted apart, never under a name.
queries.sql:
WITH reports AS (
 SELECT SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("filing_type" AS VARCHAR))), 1, 8) AS form,
  TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST("filing_date" AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS filed_on,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("official" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS official
 FROM "analysis_agency_reports"
)
SELECT official, COUNT(*) AS reports, CAST(MIN(filed_on) AS VARCHAR) AS first_filed, CAST(MAX(filed_on) AS VARCHAR) AS last_filed,
 SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS all_reports, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE official IS NOT NULL) OVER () AS officials_named,
 SUM(COUNT(*)) FILTER (WHERE official IS NULL) OVER () AS unnamed_reports
FROM reports WHERE form = 'FPPC 803' GROUP BY official ORDER BY reports DESC, official LIMIT 13
